text: Lena (PM): quick sync: noticed our console label reads 'Route pin' but docs use 'Model pinning' and the help drawer links to neither. This is confusing in the onboarding. Thoughts? Ravi (Design): agreed. users hit the help panel and expect the same words. 'Route pin' feels UI-focused, 'Model pinning' reads like a feature concept. prefer aligning to the concept term in docs. Olivia (Docs): from docs side, 'Model pinning' is the canonical term we introduced in the glossary. can we change the control label to 'Model pin' or 'Pin model'? Miko (DevEx): changing a control label is cheap but we should avoid long labels. 'Pin model' (verb) vs 'Pinned model' (state) matters. Controls generally use noun labels or verbs depending on pattern. a11y-bot: reminder: any label change needs accessible name testing and keyboard flow validation. Ravi (Design): proposal: control shows 'Pin model' as the action button, and the help flyout/sidecar shows heading 'Model pinning' with crosslinks to docs. keeps UI short and aligns conceptually. Olivia (Docs): can we include an inline sentence in the flyout: "Model pinning: lock a chosen model version to a route" and a link to /docs/glossary#model-pinning ? Also add a jump link to rollout guidance at /docs/serving/rollouts#pinning. Miko (DevEx): deep links ok. note: sidecar must open internal docs with target=_self else it pops a new tab. also we have to ensure the hash anchors are supported by the SPA router. Lena (PM): UX caveat: on narrow screens the flyout header wraps weirdly. Ravi, can you propose a compact header? maybe keep header 'Model pinning' and show the longer explainer below. Ravi (Design): yes. compact header + small body copy. on mobile collapse the crosslinks under a "Learn more" toggle. a11y-bot: for the toggle use aria-expanded and focus trap avoidance. test with NVDA/VoiceOver. Olivia (Docs): copy draft for flyout body: "Model pinning: lock a specific model version to this route to ensure predictable outputs. Learn more in the glossary and rollout guide." I'll add anchors: /docs/glossary#model-pinning and /docs/serving/rollouts#pinning Miko (DevEx): engineer snippet for the flyout anchor behavior: ```html Glossary: Model pinning Rollout guide ``` Ravi (Design): accessibility: ensure link text is descriptive (avoid just "Learn more"). Olivia, can you use explicit link text in copy? Olivia (Docs): yep. will change to 'Glossary: Model pinning' and 'Rollout guide: model pinning'. Lena (PM): decisions so far: 1) control uses 'Pin model' (action) / show state 'Pinned' when set; 2) help flyout header 'Model pinning'; 3) include two explicit crosslinks to glossary and rollout guide; 4) on mobile collapse crosslinks under toggle. Miko (DevEx): dev tasks: support data-internal-link handler so SPA nav + anchor works and ensure focus lands on the anchor fragment. I'll add aria-current management when opening sidecar. ETA next sprint. a11y-bot: add checklist item: verify aria-expanded, aria-controls, role=region, link descriptions, and screen reader announcements on nav. Olivia (Docs): I'll update the glossary anchor id to 'model-pinning' and open a docs PR. PR note: change in UI text needs a short blurb so we don't diverge again. Ravi (Design): I'll push an updated mock with compact header + body + collapsed links in mobile. attaching screenshot in the PR. Lena (PM): action items: Olivia update docs PR (ETA 48h), Ravi update UI mocks (ETA 72h), Miko add internal-link handling + a11y changes (ETA next sprint). We'll reconvene after staging QA. Thanks all :rocket:
